photos.description: Two pupils writing while a teacher points at a workbook. Natural daylight, wood desk, teal clothing, no identifiable institution.
photos.crop: Desktop: 3:2 or 4:3 with object-position 50% 50%. Keep the pointing hand and notebook in frame. Mobile: 4:3 works well; for a taller crop use object-position 59% 50% to prioritize the pupil and teacher's hand. Avoid headline text over faces. The orange book at far right can be cropped away.
photos.verification: Primary photo page confirms author and Free to use; downloaded full JPEG inspected visually.

photos.photographer: cottonbro studio (download credited cottonbro; EXIF artist/copyright Dimenshteyn)
photos.description: Real photo of hands arranging a paper backpack with pencils, ruler and eraser against a soft blue surface. Warm peach paper, pale blue background, natural wood pencils.
photos.crop: Desktop: retain 3:2 and the generous open left side; subject occupies right half. Mobile: 4:5 crop with object-position 78% 50%, ensuring both hands remain visible. Useful as a supporting supplies detail rather than another large people photo.
photos.verification: Exact primary Pexels search-result download links to this file and credits cottonbro in the download filename; full JPEG inspected visually. Individual photo page could not be resolved via web tool.
photos.fit_note: More deliberately arranged than a candid workspace; selected for the cohesive blue, warm neutral palette and region-neutral school context.
